canDoYue: 你識講邊樣跟得上進度、邊次樣辦落後、星期五跟進、寫低問題同行動。
canDoEn: Say what is on track, which sample run is behind, and who will follow up by Friday with a written note.

dialogue.speaker: sora
dialogue.text: Our design work is on track, so the meeting can stay short.
dialogue.glossYue: 設計工作跟得上進度，所以個會可以短啲。
dialogue.say: Our design work is on track, so the meeting can stay short.

dialogue.speaker: nina
dialogue.text: Which sample run is behind schedule, and who owns that part?
dialogue.glossYue: 邊次樣辦落後咗，邊個負責嗰部分？
dialogue.say: Which sample run is behind schedule, and who owns that part?

dialogue.speaker: sora
dialogue.text: That sample run is behind schedule, and I own it.
dialogue.glossYue: 嗰次樣辦落後咗，我負責。
dialogue.say: That sample run is behind schedule, and I own it.

dialogue.speaker: nina
dialogue.text: Can you follow up by Friday and send one written note?
dialogue.glossYue: 你可唔可以星期五之前跟進，再寫一張字條？
dialogue.say: Can you follow up by Friday and send one written note?

dialogue.speaker: sora
dialogue.text: I will follow up by Friday and send the note that day.
dialogue.glossYue: 我星期五之前會跟進，同日送出字條。
dialogue.say: I will follow up by Friday and send the note that day.

dialogue.speaker: nina
dialogue.text: Any open questions before we list each action item?
dialogue.glossYue: 寫低每項行動之前，仲有冇問題？
dialogue.say: Any open questions before we list each action item?

dialogue.speaker: sora
dialogue.text: The action item is mine, and I will call the client Friday.
dialogue.glossYue: 呢項行動我負責，我星期五會打畀客戶。
dialogue.say: The action item is mine, and I will call the client Friday.

dialogue.speaker: nina
dialogue.text: Send that note after the meeting so I can read it.
dialogue.glossYue: 會後請送張字條嚟，等我睇。
dialogue.say: Send that note after the meeting so I can read it.
